concepts.name: pomeranian
concepts.subject: a very endearing fluffy cream Pomeranian puppy gently hugging a single folded-corner PDF document, with a curious slight head tilt, soft dark eyes, small rounded snout, little paws and a fluffy curled tail. Make the face feel like an expressive hand-animated storybook animal rather than a shiny kawaii sticker
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one standalone square desktop application icon concept for MyPdf. Primary request: a charming puppy app mascot in the warm hand-drawn aesthetic of a Studio Ghibli-inspired 2D animated film: delicate slightly imperfect dark umber pencil/ink contours, soft watercolor and gouache paint fills, subtle paper-like pigment inside the character, restrained cel shading, gentle earthy colors, expressive understated face, cozy and sincere rather than glossy commercial clipart. Subject: a very endearing fluffy cream Pomeranian puppy gently hugging a single folded-corner PDF document, with a curious slight head tilt, soft dark eyes, small rounded snout, little paws and a fluffy curled tail. Make the face feel like an expressive hand-animated storybook animal rather than a shiny kawaii sticker. Include a pale ivory document with a folded corner and a small muted coral-red rounded label bearing the exact uppercase text 'PDF' in clear off-white letters. Composition: tightly unified centered icon, complete puppy silhouette fully within square frame, face dominant and readable, a few large simple shapes that still work at 48 or 64 pixels, 12% transparent safe margin. Actual transparent alpha background. No scenery, no grass, no buildings, no background color tile, no paper canvas background, no ground shadow, no stars, no sparkles, no decorative objects, no watermark, no extra text besides PDF. Avoid giant glossy anime eyes, plastic 3D rendering, neon colors, over-detailed fur, photorealism. A new puppy character, not a copy of any existing film character.
